responsibilities: Design, build, and optimize analytical workflows and dashboards using Tableau, SQL, and AWS-based databases.
Translate complex business requirements into performant data models and dashboards, using AI tools to explore different approaches and find the best way to solve each problem.
Use AI assistants to accelerate everyday work – drafting and optimizing SQL, troubleshooting calculations, suggesting visualization approaches, and checking data quality.
Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insight – summaries, commentary, and recommendations that business users can act on.
Critically review all AI-assisted output, so every deliverable remains accurate and trustworthy for client decision-making.
Build solutions that are scalable, reusable, and reliable, and document them so others can maintain and extend them.
Work cross-functionally with product managers, data experts, and engineers.
Support live analytics solutions, including troubleshooting and performance tuning.
